snippet.title: 『OCTOPinbs』Release Date Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Firefighters Social Deduction Game『OCTOPinbs』
Coming to Steam🄬 May 11, 2026!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2660510?utm_source=youtube

We can't stop the fire!?
Catch the ARTISTS hiding amongst the firefighters!

公式サイト：https://octopinbs.com/en/
公式X：https://x.com/OCTOPinbs
公式Tiktok：https://www.tiktok.com/@octopinbs_official
Discord：https://discord.com/invite/octopinbs

Steam Page：https://store.steampowered.com/app/2660510?utm_source=youtube

＜Product Details＞
Title：　　OCTOPinbs
Genre：　Multiplayer Action Game
Release Date：Monday, May 11 at 6:00 PM (PDT)
Price：　 $9.99
Platform：Steam🄬
Languages：Japanese, English, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese, German, Korean, Spanish, French
Players： 3-10 people
